verdict.rationale: llamafile is a self-contained local executable that bundles model weights, inference engine and server, so the core product runs entirely on the user's own device with no cloud dependency. Hands-on community reports confirm it runs locally and offline on Linux and Windows. Missing for 10: documented deployment of large models on Windows beyond the 4GB executable limit, and reliable GPU acceleration without extra toolchain installs (community-reported caveats).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Models run entirely on your device. No cloud, no data sharing, no external dependencies. Works fully offline for privacy-first AI workflows.
llamafile is the model, runtime, and server in one file.
collapses all the complexity of LLMs down to a single-file executable (called a "llamafile") that runs locally on most operating systems and CPU architectures, with no installation.
worked easily on desktop Linux, first try. It appears to execute with zero network connection
